verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI supports LLM-driven extraction and query-style commands (e.g. 'crwl ... -q "Extract all product prices"') plus adaptive crawling that uses information-foraging algorithms to decide when enough data has been gathered to answer a query, which is a limited form of in-product AI reasoning over scraped data. However, this is extraction/query-answering, not a built-in insights or suggestions feature (dashboards, summaries, recommendations) — the product mainly hands clean markdown/JSON to external LLMs rather than generating its own insights. Missing for 10: a dedicated insights/summary UI or proactive suggestion mechanism, evidence of the product itself surfacing analysis rather than just extracted data, and independent corroboration of this specific capability.
